text:
Emma: dropping a new iteration of the Credentials list + create modal. main goals: reduce friction for first-time users, make scope selection less intimidating, and tighten rotate/revoke copy. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc

Leo: nice. first thought: show scope presets (e.g., \"CI token\", \"Read-only analytics\") as radio chips at top. users can pick a preset that auto-checks scopes. reduces decision fatigue. :sparkles:

Priya: presets are good. also add a small CLI snippet in the empty state so devs know how to use a token. e.g.:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models
```
That helped me in tests.

Mark: rotate flow: prefer single modal but include an \"Advanced options\" accordion for overlap window + expiry override. keep primary CTA: \"Rotate token\". add a one-line consequence: \"This will immediately revoke the current token.\"

Emma: on the create modal I'm proposing these defaults: expiry = 90 days, preset = \"Read-only\", scopes shown as compact chips with an \"Add scopes\" searchable checklist. chips should be removable.

Leo: UI nit: when chips overflow, use a +N indicator that opens a popover instead of wrapping. keeps row height stable. also keyboard: arrow keys should move between chips.

Priya: accessibility: ensure each chip has an aria-label like \"scope: embeddings - selected\" and a visible focus ring. the preset radios must be grouped with aria-describedby pointing at the helper text.

Mark: empty state copy proposal (short): \"No credentials yet. Create a token to call Redwood APIs. Tokens can be limited by scope and expiry. See examples below.\" add a secondary CTA \"Learn about scopes\" linking to docs.

Emma: question about post-creation secret handling: current pattern shows the secret once with a \"Copy\" button. can we add a \"Download as .env\" link so users can store it immediately? and ensure we log a \"secret_shown\" audit event.

Leo: yes to download. also change copy button to show a success tooltip \"Copied to clipboard\" and persist that tooltip for 2s. avoid ephemeral toast for copy since it can be missed when switching windows.

Priya: A11y bot: added comment - masked secret must still be navigable to by keyboard; when revealed, move focus to the revealed text and announce via aria-live: \"Secret revealed. copy button available.\"

Mark: revoke behavior: add a soft-revoke for 10s (undoable) then escalate to full revoke. UI could show a progress bar in the toast for the undo window. for org admins, make the undo 20s.

Emma: I like the progress bar idea. copy for revoke confirmation: \"Revoke token? This will stop services using the token from authenticating.\" make the destructive CTA label \"Revoke token now\".

Leo: small design detail: warning stripe color should pass 4.5:1 for text and icons. current yellow is too pale on dark mode.

Priya: also add ARIA for the revoke modal: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and focus trap starting on the close button so keyboard users can discover the content easily.

Emma: I'll update the Figma: add presets, chips + popover for overflow, CLI sample in empty state, download .env option, undo progress bar, and the revised copy. will ping once ready.

Mark: dev follow-up - need an API spec for the preset -> scopes mapping and an endpoint to request a temporary overlap window. I'll draft a short contract.

Priya: a11y sign-off pending the live-region + focus behavior tests. thanks! :white_check_mark:

Emma: thanks all, will iterate and repost.
